block-1.title: Inclusivity
block-1.body:
Takshasheela aims to contribute to a significant shift in global consciousness through actively pursuing our commitment to foster global appreciation of our diversity as humans.

No matter the age of your body, your physical characteristics, your ethnicity, your indigeneity, what religion or spiritual path you follow, gender you identify as, your sexual orientation, political beliefs you hold, cultural or socioeconomic background you originate from, whether you identify with any of these or none of them, or anything else which makes you the unique and beautiful human being that you are, Takshasheela invites you to join our community and welcomes the contribution your difference makes.

block-2.title: Turiya and Rafia, Founders of Takshasheela
block-2.body:
Rafia Morgan and Turiya Hanover, over the last 40 years, have been trained in a multitude of therapeutic modalities. For a great part of that time they also received personal guidance and life-training from an enlightened master, which has given them a deep understanding and great sensitivity to the powerful, yet subtle inter-relatedness of psychological issues and the realisation of our true spiritual nature.

In their experience, only when we bring psychological and spiritual work together is true transformation possible. This synthesis truly enhances deep and lasting growth. With this approach we discover that every emotional and psychological issue is actually a potential doorway to grounded and embodied awakening.
block-2.image_alt: Rafia Morgan and Turiya Hanover laughing on a bench

block-1.title: What is Ayurveda?
block-1.body:
Ayurveda is a time-tested healing science from India that focuses on restoring balance between the body, mind, and spirit. At Takshasheela Ayurveda Aashram, we use this sacred knowledge to guide guests towards natural harmony, vitality, and inner peace.

Through personalised care, nourishing food, herbal support, mindful movement, and restorative therapies, Ayurveda helps create lasting wellbeing rather than temporary relief.
block-1.image_alt: A calm natural setting for Ayurvedic care

block-2.title: Three energies shape our individual nature.
block-2.body: Ayurveda describes Vata, Pitta, and Kapha as patterns formed by the five elements. Everyone carries all three in a unique proportion.

block-3.title: Vata
block-3.body: Vata represents movement, creativity, and adaptability. When balanced, it supports lightness and clear expression; steady routines, warmth, and rest help calm its changeable qualities.
block-3.image_alt: Airy grasses and flowing fabric representing Vata dosha

block-4.title: Pitta
block-4.body: Pitta represents transformation, digestion, focus, and discernment. When balanced, it supports clarity and purpose; cooling foods, moderation, and spaciousness soften its intensity.
block-4.image_alt: Warm copper, water, and botanicals representing Pitta dosha

block-5.title: Kapha
block-5.body: Kapha represents structure, nourishment, steadiness, and endurance. When balanced, it brings calm and resilience; movement, variety, and lightness help enliven its grounded nature.
block-5.image_alt: Earth, water, stones, and green leaves representing Kapha dosha

block-1.title: Restoring harmony between body, mind, and spirit.
block-1.body: At Takshasheela Ayurveda Aashram, our approach is centered on restoring harmony through personalized therapies, nourishing food, and a peaceful environment.

block-2.title: Holistic Healing
block-2.body: We focus on the whole person rather than isolated symptoms, helping guests regain strength, clarity, and inner balance.

block-3.title: Personalized Care
block-3.body: Every treatment plan is shaped around the individual’s needs, comfort, and wellness goals for a more meaningful experience.

block-4.title: Nature-Centered Living
block-4.body: Our serene surroundings, mindful routines, and restorative atmosphere support healing in a calm and grounding way.

block-5.title: Personalised support in a peaceful environment.
block-5.body:
Individual Ayurvedic consultation and care planning, therapeutic treatments, nourishing meals, mindful movement, and restorative routines all work together.

Compassionate guidance from experienced wellness practitioners helps every guest feel held throughout the process.

block-6.title: A slower rhythm for genuine renewal.
block-6.body:
Guests experience a calm and welcoming atmosphere, space for rest, reflection, and renewal, and practices that support long-term wellbeing.

The aim is a deeper connection with self, nature, and inner balance.
